note: Rawlins County (FIPS 20153) parcel polygons are not published as a public queryable ArcGIS service or file. Kansas parcels are distributed through the state ORKA/PORKA portal, which requires registration and per-county approval of a data request. The Kansas ArcGIS server (services.kansasgis.org) has ORKA folders with subdivisions, lots, roads and ag-use layers but no Rawlins parcel polygon layer. No Rawlins County GIS endpoint was found on the county appraiser or GIS pages. Commercial vendors (Regrid, DynaMo, Rockford Map) sell parcel files, which do not count as county publication.
